Commentary.Commentary: Right then, we have had a blistering start to the series with India coming out on top in a humdinger of a contest to take a 1-0 lead in the series. West Indies will be pumped up after that batting performance and will look to level the series. The 2nd ODI will be played on Sunday, the 24th of July at the same venue and it will begin at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT) but our build-up will begin much sooner. Do join us then. Take care and goodbye!

The captain of India, Shikhar Dhawan (97 off 99 balls) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. Dhawan says he is happy to score runs but disappointed on missing the century. Adds that they needed partnership at the front as he knew it won't be easy for the inexperienced middle order. Informs there were nerves while bowling in the fag end but they held onto their nerves and made a couple of changes on the field. Shares that they used the bigger side as much as possible. Tells they want to keep on learning and make themselves better for the rest of the competition.

West Indies skipper, Nicholas Pooran says it feels like a win, a bitter-sweet match. Adds they wanted to play 50 overs and they did the job. Adds they did justice to the talent and showed what they are capable of. Hopes with the performance they go strength to strength against this kind of formidable side. Shares that bowlers did really well in the second half of the innings. He was looking for something around 315 but the bowlers did well. Adds that it's a good sign after the Bangladesh series. Mentions that he knows there will be many challenges but they need to stay positive.
Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Nicholas Pooran won the toss and opted to bowl first which proved to be a wrong decision as the Indian openers scored 73 runs in the first 10 overs itself. West Indies did pick up a few wickets but with the opposition just three down, the hosts were on the back foot. The top 3 for India all scored runs and put them in a great position to get a big total. The Indian innings crumbled in the final 10 overs and most of it was due to some really good bowling from the Windies pacers but India managed to cross the 300-run mark which is always a positive thing. West Indies fought tooth and nail in the chase and showed that they can bat under pressure but no one from the top order managed to bat through. The Indian bowling attack got the wickets and managed to see off the opposition, winning by a very small margin in the end.

India will be a relieved side as after posting big total on the board, they would have expected to win by a more comfortable margin but they were challenged to dig deep. Mohammed Siraj got the early breakthrough for his side but after that, the Indian bowlers were treated to a bit of hammering. Shardul Thakur who proved to be expensive early on came back in the middle overs and got his side back on top after which India had a strong grip on the game. The Indian bowlers managed to pick up wickets at regular intervals but were never able to shut out the opposition which almost proved too costly in the end.

Heartbreak for West Indies as they managed to get in touching distance of the total but fell agonizingly short. Even though the hosts lost the match, seeing contributions throughout the batting order will be a big positive for them going forward as they even managed to play the complete quota of 50 overs, only for the 7th time in about 40 matches. Kyle Mayers was prolific at the top order and Shamarh Brooks supported him well. King got a half-century but it was the fight put up by Akeal Hosein and especially Romario Shepherd that got the Windies ever so close to chasing down the target. In the end, it proved to be a mountain too steep to climb but they will look to level the series in the next game.

An absolute thrilling encounter that went down to the wire to get the series underway but it is Mohammed Siraj who has managed to hold his nerves and seal the victory for his side. India just about edge West Indies to take a 1-0 lead in the three-match ODI series.

Bye! Siraj holds his nerves! This is full and around leg. Shepherd tries to heave across but misses. A boundary was needed but Shepherd fails to connect. Siraj is pumped up. Shepherd is disappointed as he is on his knees with head down. India win by 3 runs.
Two runs! 5 runs needed now! Are we heading to a super over? This is full and outside off. Shepherd pushes it to long off and again runs for his life to complete two runs.
Wide! Siraj spills it down the leg side. Shepherd misses his flick. The keeper does really well to get a hand on it. Wided.
TWO RUNS! Full again around leg. Shepherd again swings his bat. Mistimes his heave and it rolls to short fine leg. Superb commitment from Shepherd as he wants to finish it. Two taken.
FOUR! 10 needed now! This is full and on leg. Shepherd opens his body and it nutmegs as it races to deep square leg for a boundary.
Leg bye! This is full and way outside off. Hosein tries to paddle it away but plays all over it. The ball hits the pads and it rolls towards short third man as the batters sneak in a leg bye.
A widish yorker, outside off and Hosein fails to get bat on it. Just get Shepherd on the strike, is what needed right now for West Indies.

FOUR! Just what West Indies wanted! 15 needed from the last over! This is full and outside off. Shepherd again shows his power as he swings his bat, doesn't connect well but the ball flies off the outside edge to third man for a boundary.
Fuller ball on off. Hosein doesn't get the whole of it as he tries to whip away to deep square leg. A single.
Short of a length and on off. Shepherd mistimes his pull to long on for a single.
Again this is full and way outside off. Shepherd fails to get any bat on it.

Not out it is! A full ball, outside off, over the tramline. Shepherd has to reach for it and he throws his bat at it but misses. An appeal for caught behind and the finger goes up. Shepherd reviews it immediately. Ultra Edge shows no bat there and the on-field decision needs to be changed.
SIX! One of many required for the Windies! A juicy full toss on middle. Shepherd stays back and thumps it over long on for a biggie. 21 needed now.
Prasidh Krishna (9-1-50-0) to bowl the penultimate over of the innings.
A full toss outside off. Shepherd has a freebie but ends up hitting to long off for a single. 27 needed now off 12 balls.
FOUR! Shepherd will take it however it comes! This is full and tailing around leg. Shepherd clears his front leg and tries to heave but gets an inside edge and it races into the fine leg fence.
A perfect widish yorker, outside off. Hosein jams it out to covers for a single.
Tries the yorker on middle. Shepherd works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Siraj serves it full and outside off, this one nips back in. Shepherd makes room and leaves it alone in the end.
Four leg byes! A boundary to start the over! Spills it on the pads, Shepherd misses his flick and the ball rolls behind off the pads and to fine leg.
Flighted, full and outside off. Shepherd drives it on the up to deep cover for a single. 38 needed in 18 balls.
A full toss on off. Hosein steps across and drives it to long on for a single.
A loopy ball, outside off. Shepherd lofts it over covers and the fielder at deep keeps it down to one.
Chahal tries to keep away from the batter and does well. It is hit to point.
SIX! Much needed! Shepherd reads the flight as this is full and outside off. He uses his long lever and smacks it straight down for a biggie.
Tossed up, outside off. Shepherd smashes it hard but finds point.
Nails a yorker, on middle. Shepherd gets his bat down and jams it out t o square leg for a single.
Too full and outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
Wide! Sees Hosein shuffling way outside off. Siraj serves it way down the leg side. Good take from the keeper. The umpire takes his time before calling a wide.
Short again on middle. Shepherd pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Length and on middle. Defended out.
Short, slower and outside off. Shepherd pulls it to deep mid-wicket, in the gap for two runs.
A full toss, outside off. Hosein slashes it to deep cover for one.
Tossed up, outside off, Romario Shepherd gets an outside edge that runs down to third man and the batters come back for two. 54 needed now off 30 balls.
Pushed through quicker and fuller, well outside off. Romario Shepherd looks to powerfully drive it away but completely misses the ball.
On the shorter side, close to the off pole. Hosein punches it off the back foot through cover for a run.
Romario Shepherd is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another Windies batter gives away his wicket at the wrong time and Yuzvendra Chahal has done the trick again for his side. This is bowled flatter and around off, turning away. Brandon King goes after it and tries to lift it over extra cover. The ball goes high off the toe end of the bat and towards deep extra cover where Shreyas Iyer takes a simple catch. King walks back in disappointment and now 57 runs are needed off 33 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Shreyas Iyer b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter in length but slower through the air and well outside off. This one turns away as well, King cuts it towards sweeper cover and hurries back for the second.
Quicker delivery, pushed wider, Hosein steps down the track and edges it down to short third man for a quick run. 250 is up now for West Indies.
Full and wide again, this time Hosein manages to slash it away towards deep cover for a single.
And again! Very full, almost a low full toss and well outside off, Hosein just can't seem to get his bat on the full and wide ones.
Top delivery! Nails the wide yorker, angling across the left-hander and staying inside the tramline. Akeal Hosein is beaten for pace.
Banged in short and pushed well outside off, Akeal Hosein throws his hands at it and manages to loft it over extra cover for a couple of runs.
Brilliant execution from Prasidh Krishna, nails the yorker on leg stump. King jams it out on the off side and collects a single.
Very full and on leg stump, Brandon King fails to dig it out and gets hit on the pads.

FOUR! A boundary to end a fruitful over for the Windies, 13 coming off it. Chahal drags it down on off stump, Akeal Hosein stands tall and hammers it back over the bowler's head for a boundary. 64 needed now off 42 balls.
This is speared into the leg stump, King sweeps it hard and towards deep mid-wicket for just a single.
Quicker delivery, well outside off, King moves past the off stump but can't get it past the man at backward point.
Pushes this one wider, Hosein reaches out and plays it through covers for one more.
FIFTY for Brandon King and it has been a fighting knock from him so far but he will know that the job is not done yet. Around off and turning away, this is driven towards sweeper cover for a single.

SIX! Yuzvendra Chahal is welcomed into the new spell with a slog-sweep. This is tossed up on leg stump and it is the leg break. Brandon King slogs it away against the turn and dispatches it over the mid-wicket fence for a huge hit. West Indies need more of the same now.
And again! Excellent from Krishna, gets it full and wide, just inside the tramline and Hosein once again can't get any bat on it.
Full and very wide, Akeal Hosein shuffles past the off stump but fails to get any bat on it.
Length ball, slanted onto middle. King backs away but can only manage to hit it towards long on and collect a single.
Much better from Krishna, gets it in the blockhole around off. Hosein jams it out towards extra cover and scampers through for one.
WIDE! Too full and too wide from Krishna, Hosein can't reach it and the umpire signals a wide.
Good length on off, this is pulled through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Well timed! Slower delivery, full and on middle stump. Brandon King picks it up well and just strokes it right back past the bowler, beating the diving fielder at long on.
Excellent running! On the pads again, Akeal Hosein works it past square leg and races back for the second. 85 needed now off 54 balls.
On the pads, this is pushed away onto the leg side for a single.

NOT OUT! Nicely flighted from Axar Patel and delivered on middle stump. The ball grips again and turns away sharply, beating the bat of Brandon King who is on the front feet looking to block it out. Sanju Samson whips off the bails in a flash and appeals for a stumping. The replay shows that King dragged his foot back in time.
On middle and leg, Hosein works it well in front of mid-wicket for a single.
On leg stump, flicked away towards square leg.
Bye! Lovely delivery from Axar Patel, on off and this one grips and turns. Brandon King is beaten past the outside edge and the keeper is beaten too. The batters scamper through for a bye.
Powerplay 3! The fielding team can now have up to 5 fielders outside the inner ring.
Length and outside off. Hosein mistimes his punch to covers.
Leg bye! Bowls it slow and keeps it on the pads. King misses his heave and it goes off the pads to square leg.
FOUR! A welcome and much needed boundary! Slower again but this is full and outside off. King drives it to deep point for four.
A slower bumper, around off. King tries to ramp it away but misses.
Length ball on off. King pulls it hard but straight to mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off. King bottom edges it to point.
Prasidh Krishna (6-1-34-0) is back for his third spell.
Fuller and outside off. King skips down and drives it to deep extra-cover where Hooda is qucik to stop it. A single.
Short and outside off, drifting in. King stays back to cut but misses.
Patel targets the pads, it is flicked to deep square leg for one.
Length ball, around off. King punches it through point for one more.
Flatter and on the pads. Hosein nudges it behind square on the leg side for one.
This is full and on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Hosein takes a wide outside off guard and Thakur serves it very full. Hosein squeezes it out to long off for a single.
Consecutive no balls! Poor from Thakur! This is too full and outside off. Hosein carves it straight to point. Free hit will stay.
No ball! Fuller and outside off. Hosein drives it to cover. A late no ball is called for overstepping and a Free hit will follow.
Again on the pads. Hosein plays it fine to fine leg and a fumble by Chahal allows a couple of runs.
FOUR! Much needed! On a length and on the pads. Hosein steps across and whacks it to deep square leg for a single.
Short in length, outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
On middle, blocked out.

Three runs! Overthrows! A length ball, outside off. Hosein pushes it to deep point for a brace. The throw from Patel is a hard one for the keeper to grab as it is over him and the batters get one more run.
Shardul Thakur (7-0-41-2) is back on.
Too full and on off. Hosein drills it to long on for a single.
Akeal Hosein is in at number 7.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Yuzvendra Chahal gets his first wicket! Chahal serves it slow and floats one on a length and outside off, turning away. Powell tries to play with soft hands but ends up getting an outside edge to first slip where Deepak Hooda holds onto it. West Indies need 113 more runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepak Hooda b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Dhawan showing some off-cricket skills! A googly, outside off. King punches it to covers. Dhawan stops it and does push-ups!
Touch short and on off, spinning away. King tucks it to mid-wicket.
A loopy ball, outside off, Powell pushes it to long off for one.
Touch fuller and outside off. Powell guides it to third man for a single.
Angles it on the pads. Powell tucks it to mid-wicket. Good stop there.
FOUR! Powell is off the mark! Short of a length and on middle. Powell pulls it to deep square leg and beats the diving fielder for a boundary.
On a length and outside off. Powell dabs it to point.
Full and on off. Powell keeps it out.
Rovman Powell is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Pooran goes and India get the breakthrough! Siraj serves a full ball, outside off. Pooran steps across and tries to heave across but plays off the bottom of the bat and to mid on where Prasidh Krishna takes it cleanly. Bad shot selection and he pays the price.
Commentary.Howout: c Prasidh Krishna b Mohammed Siraj

Commentary.Commentary: Floats it up full and on off stump. Nicholas Pooran leans in and plays it with soft hands towards cover-point for a quick single. 120 needed now off 90 deliveries.
Shorter this time, pushed wider and turning even further away. King reaches out and cuts it towards deep point for a run.
Very full this time and on the pads, King fails to sweep it away.
Nicely tossed up, full and well outside off. Brandon King drives it straight to the man at extra cover.
On middle and leg, this is turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Starts off the new spell with a flatter delivery on middle. Nicholas Pooran works it away towards mid on.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for just a single.
Length ball, pushed wide of the off stump. Pooran goes hard at it but mistimes it badly towards the cover region.
Full and angling across the left-hander, Pooran looks to straight drive but mistimes it back towards the bowler.
On a hard length and slanting in from outside off. King hangs back and taps it towards cover for a run.
On a fullish length and close to the off pole, Pooran just guides it down to third man for one more.
Starts off the new spell with a yorker-length delivery on middle and leg. King jams it out towards mid on and sprints across for a quick single.

Drinks! West Indies did lose both the set batters in quick succession but Pooran and King have done well since then to build a stand. 127 runs are needed in 102 balls and West Indies have 7 wickets in hand. They will feel pretty confident to chase this down. India need a couple of wickets to put pressure back on the opposition. A halt in play as Mohammed Siraj has some issue near his landing area. The groundsman comes in with a bucket full of sawdust.
Full and on leg stump, this is nudged away through mid-wicket for a single. 127 needed now off 102 deliveries.
Flatter delivery, around off, this is tapped towards cover.
SIX! Flighted this time from Axar Patel and around off. Brandon King uses his feet well and gets to the pitch of the ball before powering it over the long off fence for a biggie.
Holds it back a touch and bowls it around off, King defends it out.
Quicker this time, on middle, Pooran manages to dab it down towards short third man for a quick single.
On a length and sliding onto middle and leg, King pushes it off the back foot and down to long on for a single.
A dot to end an expensive over, 15 coming off it. Goes a bit fuller and slower, outside off, Pooran leaves this one alone.
SIX! And again! Prasidh Krishna comes from around the wicket but again serves a short ball. Pooran hits it flat and powerfully but in front of square this time for another maximum.
SIX! BANG! Krishna keeps on bowling short and this is around the hips, Nicholas Pooran swivel-pulls it well over the square leg fence for a biggie. The skipper holds the key here for his side.
On a shorter length and angled onto the body, King manages to get it through mid on for one more.
Nicely bowled! A slower short ball, well outside off. Brandon King hops and looks to cut it away but is beaten due to the lack of pace.
Crunched but straight to the man. Just a fraction short and over middle, Pooran pulls it hard but finds the fielder as deep mid-wicket, just a single then.
WIDE! An attempted slower ball, full and spilled way down the leg side.
This is pushed through on off, Nicholas Pooran leans in and pushes it down to long off for one.
On a length and on the pads, Pooran turns it towards square leg.
Around off, this is played through covers for a single.
Quicker and flatter, very close to the off pole. The ball turns away as King looks to drive and get an outside edge towards third man, picks up yet another brace.
Good running! Full and outside off, this is driven through extra cover for a couple of runs.
Sliding it in from well outside off, King taps it towards point.
Short in length and outside off. King slaps it to deep cover for one more. West Indies need 157 from 120 balls.
On the hips, flicked to deep square leg for a single.

A direct hit and Pooran was a goner! This is on a length and around off. Pooran punches it to mid off and calls for a quick single. He doesn't get the same response from the other end and has to run back. Siraj misses his shy at the keeper's end and Pooran gets back in.
Length and around off. Pooran solidly blocks it.
On a length and outside off. Punched to deep cover for a single. 150 up for West Indies!
Fuller and on off. Pooran taps it in front of point for a single.
Prasidh Krishna (4-1-15-0) is back into the attack.
Drops it short and outside off. King cuts it hard but straight to the fielder at point.
Gives a bit of width, outside off. Pooran punches it through covers for a single.
Patel serves it quicker, flatter and on middle. Pooran defends under his eyes.
Targets the stumps. King forces it to long on for a single.
Slower, length and outside off. King guides it but straight to short third man.
Flatter and outside off. King punches it to covers.
On off, kept out.
Leg bye! Fuller and on the pads. King misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but it was angling down. It rolls to square leg for a leg bye.
Pitches it up this time, Pooran just plays it with soft hands towards mid off for a single.
Back of a length and outside off, this is guided down to third man foe a single by King.
Banged in halfway down the track and over middle, Brandon King hops back to keep it down.
Back of a length and outside off, this is cut away to deep point for a single.
Smart from King! Slightly short and outside off. King waits and steers it past first slip to third man for a brace.
Flatter and outside off. King dabs it to point.
Full, drifting in on middle. King defends on the front foot.
Tossed up on off. King leans and blocks it.
Around off on a length. Pooran punches it through covers for a single.
On a length and outside off. King slaps it to deep point for a single.
Axar Patel (1-0-14-0) is back on.
Length ball, outside off, angling across. Pooran looks to chase at it but misses.
The skipper, Nicholas Pooran walks in at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Thakur gets another one! Mayers has given away his wicket here! This is full and way outside off. Mayers looks to drive away from the body and his foot is rooted to the crease. It takes the outside edge and Samson pouches it safely. Another set-batter goes.
Commentary.Howout: c Sanju Samson b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: Length and outside off. King plays with soft hands to third man for a single.
This is full and around off. King pushes and Thakur does well to get a hand on it.
Hits the deck hard on top of off. King blocks it out.
Length ball, angling on middle. King defends on the front foot.
Tossed up around middle, Mayers uses his feet but doesn't get it past the man at mid on. At the halfway mark, West Indies are 137/2. 172 needed now off 150 deliveries.
On middle and King knocks it down to long on for one more.
Around middle and leg, this is turned through mid-wicket for a run.
Slowed up on this occasion and it is the leg-break, turning in from off stump. Kyle Mayers looks to defend off the front foot but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg.
Around off, this is driven through wide mid off for an easy single.
Bowls it full and around, a bit quicker as well. King defends it under his eyeline.
Length again, around off, this is played on the up towards deep cover for a single.
Around the top of off, Brandon King blocks it out.
Brandon King is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The short ball has done the trick again and Shardul Thakur breaks the partnership. Thakur digs in a short ball around off and it is there to be hit. Shamarh Brooks hangs back and there's no foot movement as he goes for the pull. Brooks is never in control of the shot and gets it off the toe end of the bat towards deep square leg. Shreyas Iyer over there takes a good low catch and Brooks departs after a good innings. This might be the opening India needed.
Commentary.Howout: c Shreyas Iyer b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: Length again, angling into middle stump, Mayers just knocks it down to long on and rotates the strike.
A length ball, on middle, Brooks pushes it down the ground towards long on for a single.
On a good length and outside off, this is tapped towards cover-point.
Flatter this time, around off. Mayers punches it towards cover.
FOUR! Chahal errs in line and floats it up down the leg side. Kyle Mayers gets down on one knee and paddles it into the fine leg fence.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Shamarh Brooks takes a step towards the ball and caresses it through extra cover for a run.
Slightly tossed up and on middle, Brooks defends it off the front foot.
This is pushed through quicker on the pads, Brooks tickles it away to short fine leg.
On a nagging length and on the pads, this is worked away past square leg for one.
Short and wide, Kyle Mayers gets on the back foot and slashes it away to deep point for just a single. West Indies are in ascendancy at the moment.
Cross-seamer from Thakur, short and well outside off. Brooks steers it down to third man for an easy single.
This is angled into middle and leg from around the stumps, Mayers plays a checked drive down to long on for one more.
Gentle-paced delivery, full and outside off. Brooks drives it through extra cover for a single.
Good length, around off, this is nudged away onto the leg side.

SIX! Up and away! Shardul Thakur starts the new spell with a shortish delivery on off, Shamarh Brooks just hangs back and powers it over the vacant long on fence for a maximum. The 100 partnership is up between these two.
FOUR! Just a fraction short and around off, Mayers latches onto it and cuts it through cover-point for a boundary. 12 runs coming off it.
Drifted onto middle and leg, Brooks comes forward and drives it down to long off for a single.
On middle, Brooks sweeps it away towards backward square leg.
Flighted, around off, Mayers goes after it and plays it uppishly to the right of the man at point. The fielder over there gets a hand on it as the batters pick up a single.
SIX! Finally, Kyle Mayers has had enough of it and decides to go big. Tossed up around off, Mayers skips down the track and lifts it high and over the long off fence for a biggie.
Bowls it full and on off, Mayers leans in and drivges it towards mid off.
Similar line, slightly short. Brooks forces it to mid on. The boundaries have dried up for West Indies.
A off-breaker, full and on off, Brooks tucks it to mid-wicket.
Shorter and on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Sees Myers take the charge and Hooda slows it up and serves outside off. Mayers dabs in the end to point.
Tossed up, outside off, Kyle punches off the back foot to covers.
Angling on the pads, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Sharp turn there! Drags his length back a bit and bowls around off, it spins back in. Mayers shaped to punch this but gets an inside edge to square leg.
Bowls this down the leg side. Mayers flicks it straight to short fine leg.
Bowls one quicker on middle. Brooks hits it to long on for a single.
A flighted delivery, full and on middle. Mayers pushes it to long off for one. 100 up for the Windies.
A googly, this is full and outside off. Mayers drives it to covers. Good fielding again.
Around leg, played back to the bowler.
Good stop by Iyer! Length and on middle. Brooks nudges it to the left of mid-wicket where Iyer dives to stop.
Flatter and outside off. Mayers drives it through covers for a run.
A loopy ball on middle, eased to long on for one.
Wide! Tries to attack the pads but spills it down leg. Brooks misses his pull.
Angles a full ball, around off. Brooks works it to covers.
Gives a bit of width, outside off, it is driven to point.
Slants one on leg. Mayers punches it to long on for one.
Keeps attacking the stumps, around off. Brooks blocks it out.
Tight from Chahal! On middle. Blocked out.
Length and outside off, a leggie and stays low. Brooks fails to cut it away.
Tossed up, around middle and off. Defended out.
Fuller and on middle. Mayers gets on the back foot and tucks it to long on for a single.
Starts with a low dipping full toss, outside off. Mayers fails to drive it away.

Drinks! Even after losing an early wicket, West Indies have done really well to score at almost run-a-ball and that is mainly due to the knock from Kyle Mayers. Mayers has shown positive intent right from the get-go and is being well supported by Shamarh Brooks. India will need to rely on their spinners to get a bit of control out there in the middle otherwise they might allow the opposition to take full control of the chase. A fascinating middle phase awaits. With that said, Yuzvendra Chahal is inserted into the attack.
Fifty for Mayers! he has done with ease and looks in good control. The most important thing is he needs to carry on and bat till deep! This is full and on off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Keeps it tight around off. Mayers pushes it back to the bowler.
Too full and way outside off, driven to deep cover for one more.
Wide! This is full but spilled down the leg side. Brooks misses his sweep.
Tossed up, outside off. Mayers drives it to deep cover for one more.
Fuller and on middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and angling on leg, eased down to long on for a single.
Length, around off, Brooks looks to drive on the up but mistimes it towards mid off.
A touch fuller and around off, this is nicely driven on the up to the man at the extra cover fence for a run.
Just a fraction short and around off, Mayers heaves it well in front of square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Slower delivery, on a length and sliding into off stump. Mayers looks to ease it through cover-point but edges it back onto the deck.
Well bowled! Gets in the yorker around off stump. Shamarh Brooks backs away a bit and squeezes it out towards deep point for one.
No ball! Length ball, slanting into leg stump. Mayers knocks it down to long on and rotates the strike. Shardul Thakur has overstepped and a Free Hit will follow.
Pitched up on off, Brooks plays it with a dead straight bat and gets it past the bowler for a single.
On off, this is just pushed down to long on for a single. West Indies staying in touch with the required rate at the moment, a good start from them.
Quicker and flatter, on leg stump, Brooks fails to get it past square leg.
On middle, this is worked away towards mid-wicket.

Misfield and four! Quicker and down leg, Shamarh Brooks sweeps it away fine, to the right of the man at fine leg. Shubman Gill over there slips and makes a mess of it as the ball ends up in the ropes.
WIDE! This is spilled down the leg side and a wide is called.
Flatter and on off stump, Kyle Mayers eases it behind point to collect a single.
Nicely drifted onto middle and leg, Mayers blocks it out on the off side.
Length again, around middle and leg, Mayers hangs back and heaves it towards deep square leg for a run.
Length ball, well outside off, Brooks taps it towards sweeper cover for one more.
On a good length and outside off, this is punched off the back foot towards deep point for a single.
Comes from around the wicket now and digs it into the pitch, over off. Kyle Mayers looks to pull this one but gets an inside edge back onto the body.
Length again, outside off, Brooks guides it down to third man for a single.
Much better from Thakur! Good length, close to the off pole and this is played with soft hands towards backward point.
WIDE! Full and trying to attack the pads but spills it down leg. Brooks misses the whip and a wide is called.
Shardul Thakur comes from the opposite end now.
Around middle and leg, this is tucked away towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Low full toss this time, on off. Shamarh Brooks fails to take advantage as he just eases it onto the leg side.
On middle again and this is pushed back towards the bowler.
Around middle, this is turned towards mid-wicket.
Switches to around the wicket for the left-hander and slides it down leg. Mayers works it past square leg and picks up a single.
Hooda starts off his spell with a length ball on middle. Brooks just knocks it down to long on for a run.
Angled in on the pads, this is flicked away towards mid-wicket. 14 off Patel's first over, an expensive one.
FOUR! Three in a row now for Kyle Mayers and he is absolutely flying here. Keeps it on a shorter length and around off, Mayers goes on the back foot again and punches it through cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Put away! Short again and around off, this is punched away through the vacant extra cover region to make it back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Uppish but in the gap! Shorter from Patel and angling in from outside off. Kyle Mayers and cuts it through the gap between backward point and short third man to find the fence.
On a length and on off, Shamarh Brooks punches it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Floats it up first up and around off, Mayers drives it past a diving fielder at extra cover for a single.
Powerplay 2! The fielding side can now have up to 4 fielders outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, Axar Patel comes on to bowl.
A single to end the over as Mayers hits this length ball to deep point.
Length ball, outside off. Mayers square drives it to deep point. Siraj has to run from covers and did really well to stop despite slipping in the process. Two taken! 50 up as well.
On a length and outside off. Brooks dabs it past backward point for one more.
Outside off, left alone by Shamarh Brooks.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Brooks! This is full and on middle. Brooks lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
FOUR! Good start to the over! Length ball on the pads. Brooks just helps it to fine leg and it races into the fence.
First change in the bowling as Shardul Thakur comes into the attack.
FOUR! Good shot! Short in length and on middle. Mayers pulls it behind square on the leg side and well past the diving fielder across from deep for four.
QUICK SINGLE! This is full and on off. Brooks drills it to mid on and takes a sharp single.
Wide! A short quick delivery, slanting around middle and leg. Brooks looks to pull but misses it. There is a stifled appeal for caught behind but nothing given.
Short of a length on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
A bumper from Siraj, around middle and leg. Mayers sits under it.
Full again on off. Brooks pushes it gently to mid off for a quick single.
Pitched up on off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! That is perfectly pierced through the gap! Length ball, just outside off. Mayers punches off the back foot, past point for a boundary.
Tight from Krishna! Length ball, around off. Mayers blocks it out.
Length and on off, pushed to covers.

Overthrow! On a length and outside off. Brooks punches it to cover and tries to take a risky single. He is sent back and the fielder misses his shy at the keeper's end. A single taken as no one is backing up.
On top of off. Brooks punches off the back foot to covers.
Full and outside off. It is hit to mid off.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Siraj keeps bowling outside off. Brooks slaps it straight to cover-point.
On a length and outside off. Brooks tries to cut again but mistimes it to the off side.
Tries a bouncer now, around off. Brooks evades it well.
Fuller and around off. Brooks on drives it to mid on.
FOUR! Almost chopped on! Length ball, outside off. Brooks tries to cut but gets a bottom edge, past the off pole and into the fine leg fence.
On a length and outside off. Brooks punches it to point where the fielder dives over it and allows a single.
Short of a length and around off. Brooks sits under it.
Short of a length and outside off. Mayers cuts it over point and to third man for a single.
Length ball from around the wicket and around off. Blocked to covers.
This is again outside off but on the fuller side. Mayers looks to drive but misses.
FOUR! Sweetly timed! On a length and outside off. Mayers punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Pitches it up to the new man and keeps it around off. Shamarh Brooks defends it out on the off side.
Shamarh Brooks walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! A lapse in concentration from Shai Hope and he gives away his wicket. After bowling consitently on fuller lengths, Mohammed Siraj digs in a short one and bowls it outside off. Hope tries to take it on and has a wild swing across the line, ends up getting a top edge which flies down to third man. Shardul Thakur over there takes a simple catch and Siraj has the early breakthrough for India.
Commentary.Howout: c Shardul Thakur b Mohammed Siraj

Commentary.Commentary: Goes back to bowling full and serves it around off, Hope drives it towards mid off.
FOUR! NIcely timed! Good length, around the top of off, Shai Hope with a firm back-foot punch past the man at cover-point and picks up a boundary.
Siraj keeps it on a fuller length and keeps attacking the stumps. Hope can only manage to defend it back to the bowler.
Full and slanted into middle and leg, Shai Hope drives it towards mid on.
Full and outside off, Mayers goes a bit too hard at it and mistimes it towards mid off.
FOUR! Krishna digs it short and around off, Kyle Mayers picks up the length early and pulls it off the back foot over mid-wicket to find the fence.
On off, Mayers looks to cut but ends up bunting it back onto the deck.
Good length, on a tight line around off stump and Mayers just can't free his arms enough to cut it away.
Just short of a length, over middle. Kyle Mayers with a firm jab off the back foot but straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Pitches it up on off, Mayers punches it towards mid off.
And again! Around middle, Shai Hope just pushes it out towards mid on.
A length ball, attacking the stumps, Hope watchfully keeps it out on the leg side.
Fuller this time and outside off, Mayers throws his hands at it again and gets a thick edge down to third man for a single.
EDGED AND FOUR! A bit of width offered by Siraj and Kyle Mayers goes after it. Mayers slashes it away past second slip and the ball races away into the third man fence.
Keeps it on a fullish length, around middle and leg and Mayers pushes it towards mid on.

Half an appeal for LBW, the bowler seems excited but that's all. A tad fuller and around leg stump, skidding through. Mayers looks to flick it away but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Pitching outside leg it seems.
A maiden to start off with from Prasidh Krishna! Good length, around off and Hope just keeps it out on the off side.
Goes a bit fuller and pushes it wider, Shai Hope looks to cover drive but mistimes it towards mid on.
Around the top of off, Hope plays it on the up and towards covers.
And again! No room allowed whatsoever, length angled into leg stump. All Hope can do is tuck it away to mid-wicket.
Length this time, around middle and leg. Hope nudges it onto the leg side.
Krishna starts off with a fullish delivery on the pads. Hope tucks it away straight to mid-wicket.
Prasidh Krishna to bowl from the other end.
Beaten! Just a touch fuller and very close to the off pole, slanting across. Kyle Mayers looks to drive but is beaten past the outside. A tidy start from Siraj, just 3 runs off the first over.
Accurate lines from Siraj so far, length again and on middle. Hope punches it straight back towards the bowler who gets a hand on it. The ball goes to the right of mid off as a single is taken.
Length again, around middle and leg, Hope manages to work it away past square leg to get off the mark with a couple of runs. West Indies are underway as well.
Length this time, angling into middle stump. Hope gets right behind the line of the ball to make the block.
Keeps it fuller and slants it onto middle and leg, Hope flicks it nicely but finds mid-wicket.
Siraj starts off with a full and straight delivery. Shai Hope solidly defends it out onto the off side.
